t: The TRACER 165mm Deep Hole Pencil Marker is a professional construction marking tool designed for marking through deep recesses and narrow drill holes. Ideal for carpenters, kitchen fitters and DIYers, this durable cylindrical marker reaches depths of up to 100mm through a 3mm hole or 145mm through a 6mm hole. The ABS body features a knurled grip for maximum control during precise marking on wood, metal, plastic, and ceramics. A debris-resistant push button ensures reliable operation on dusty job sites, while the included site holster incorporates an integrated sharpener to keep the 2H lead sharp, a pocket clip for quick access, and a precision grip for improved control during marking. An anti-roll design helps prevent the pencil from rolling off work surfaces.
